context.passage:
"E-mail*
To:
All Employees
From:
Ben Nonaka
Date:
March 22
Subject:
Important information about time-tracking software
Hello, everyone,
Please note that we will soon be retiring the Kronos time-tracking software, as it has
become too expensive for us to support two time-tracking programs. Based on the usage
data we collected from the survey you completed last week, we have decided to
continue using only the software the employees like better. Using only the Workmine
time-tracking software will allow us to provide better technical support and to maintain
consistency in our records across the company.
From April 4 to April 21, my department will offer training sessions on migrating
records to the Workmine application. Kronos users should take advantage of this
training, since they will not be able to access the Kronos program after April 25.
Starting on May 1, we will offer more-advanced Workmine training, including sessions
on creating reports and troubleshooting. Please do not hesitate to contact me if you have
questions or concerns about this transition.
Sincerely,
Ben Nonaka
Director, Information Technology
context.passage_translation:
电子邮件
收件人：全体员工
发件人：Ben Nonaka
日期：3月22日
主题：有关工时追踪软件的重要信息

大家好：

请注意，我们很快将停用 Kronos 工时追踪软件，因为同时维护两套工时追踪程序的成本已经过高。根据我们从各位上周填写的调查中收集到的使用数据，我们决定只继续使用员工更喜欢的那款软件。仅使用 Workmine 工时追踪软件，将使我们能够提供更好的技术支持，并让全公司的记录保持一致。

4 月 4 日至 4 月 21 日，我的部门将开设有关如何将记录迁移至 Workmine 应用程序的培训课程。Kronos 用户应充分利用这项培训，因为 4 月 25 日之后，他们将无法再访问 Kronos 程序。

从 5 月 1 日起，我们将提供更高级的 Workmine 培训，包括如何创建报告和排除故障的课程。如果您对此次转换有任何问题或顾虑，请随时与我联系。

此致
Ben Nonaka
信息技术总监
